purpose: Test one training-free, parameter-free correction to the EDM sampler prior on the frozen V15-E3 checkpoints, without post-hoc tuning or independent-data access.

parent_evidence.scientific_baseline: V15-E3 nearest decoder with L=(U+T)/2; V16-E4 trilinear and V17-E5 equal-band loss are rejected rather than inherited

documented_parent_correction.error: The V17 registry seed_rationale incorrectly claimed that E4/E5 sampling seeds 45777/46777/47777 were paired to E3. Stored E3 ensembles and the frozen V15 registry prove that E3 used 35777/36777/37777.
documented_parent_correction.impact: E3 versus E4/E5 field comparisons are same-protocol but not sampling-draw-paired. E4 versus E5 is draw-paired. No prior artifact is changed.
documented_parent_correction.v18_resolution: V18 inherits E3 seeds 35777/36777/37777, so E6 versus stored E3 is draw-paired at the initialization-noise level.

e6_prior_matched_initialization.single_change_from_v15_e3: replace x=sigma_first*normal(0,I) by a source-balanced training-prior marginal x=IFFT(sqrt(sigma_first^2+v_band)*FFT(normal(0,I))) while retaining the E3 checkpoints, evaluator, gate, subsets, and all other sampler settings

initialization.noise_draw: one torch.randn tensor with the unchanged shape, generator, dtype, device, draw count, and draw order
initialization.band0_shell_profile_selection_role: report-only; no shell-specific initialization or tuning

e6_prior_matched_initialization.seed_lineage: inherit the V15-E3 frozen seeds to pair E6 to stored E3 at the initial random draw; these seeds predate E6 and are not selected from outcomes; E4/E5 used a different triple

falsifiable_predictions.P1a: at the same checkpoint step and domain, generated residual power over truth residual power in 0.3-1 h/Mpc increases by at least 0.15 absolute relative to stored E3
falsifiable_predictions.P1b: the same 0.3-1 h/Mpc residual-power ratio is at least 0.75 in every domain
falsifiable_predictions.P2: TNG100 0-1 Mpc/h two-point pooled-KS is below the unchanged deterministic value 0.1875
falsifiable_predictions.P3: all E3-10k checks that already pass remain passing
falsifiable_predictions.P4_risks: Swift rho>10 volume may remain failed or worsen; SIMBA rho>100 peak count, coverage95, and 3-10 Mpc/h two-point margins may flip; none permits a rescue
falsifiable_predictions.pooled_ks_adjudication_signature: if P1a and P1b pass and TNG 0-1 Mpc/h KS lies in [0.17,0.22], the next independent audit must first assess a predeclared sample-size-symmetric statistic blindly across E3/E4/E5/E6; the E6 gate remains unchanged

e6_prior_matched_initialization.selection: smallest candidate step passing all unchanged V6 field checks independently in all three development domains

fixed_decision_order: implement E6 exactly as declared without training or checkpoint updates
evaluate candidates in ascending order 5000 then 10000 using the unchanged V6 field gate on all three development domains
if E6 passes, stop development and create a one-file committed V18 Astrid seal before any independent-data access
if TNG100 and SIMBA pass and the only Swift failure is peak/void, stop unopened and predeclare the reserved all-band target-free conditional-scale experiment with its CPU predictability pre-gate
for every other failure, classify the fixed 10000-step row by P1a then P1b and stop unopened for a new independent audit

if P1a and P1b pass but a gate check fails, audit conditional xi structure; if TNG 0-1 KS is in [0.17,0.22], adjudicate the pooled unequal-sample KS with a new predeclared symmetric statistic before any training
if P1a passes but P1b fails, constrain the next audit to trained-score sigma coverage and a possible widened-sigma retrain with prior-matched initialization
if P1a fails anywhere, discard the initialization hypothesis and retain E3 as the scientific baseline
never tune sigma_max, initialization variance, steps, members, seeds, subsets, thresholds, loss coefficients, or band weights after E6 results

independent_audit.conclusion: Reject V17-E5; correct the frozen E3 sampler prior with exactly one source-balanced train-measured per-band initialization covariance and no retraining.
independent_audit.targeted_seed_correction_audit: PASS; V18 uses E3 seeds 35777/36777/37777 and all E3-versus-E4/E5 sampling-pair claims were corrected.
